_comment: Hook Center file-event registration for Claude Code (.claude/settings.local.json) AND Codex (hooks.json) -- both share the PostToolUse shape, so the same command works. Register on the file tools; the host pipes the tool event JSON to menhir_file_event.py on stdin, which normalizes it to a file_changed event and POSTs to /api/tool-events. Fail-open: never blocks the tool, uploads no file content. Use absolute paths (any Python 3; the script is stdlib-only). Set MENHIR_TOOL_EVENTS_URL if menhir is not on the default :8100.
